simple.meaning: מִבְצָר (mibtsâr) appears 37 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with flocks.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Numbers, Joshua, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, 2 Kings, and 11 more, beginning at Numbers 13:19. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as city, land, Israel.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows מִבְצָר through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.short: a fortification , castle , or fortified city; figuratively, a defender
definitions.full: H4013. mibtsar or mibtsarah מִבְצָר noun masculine Isa 17:3 fortification — מִבְצָר Numbers 32:71 18 t.; construct מִבְצַר Josh 19:29 2 t.; plural מִבְצָרִים Num 13:19 ; Dan 11:24 ; מִבְצָרוֺת 11:15 ; מִבְצְרֵי Lam 2:2 ; Dan 11:39 ; suffix מִבְצָרֶיךָ Hosea 10:14 2 t.; מִבְצָרַיִךְ Nahum 3:12 ; מִבְצָרָ֑יִךְ 3:14 ; Jer 48:18 ; מִבְצָרָיו Psa 89:41 ; Lam 2:5 ; מִבְצָרֶיהָ Isa 34:13 ; מִבְצְרֵיהֶם 2Kin 8:12 ; — fortification , especially in phrase מ (ערי) ׳עיר ׅ׳(המ = fortified city Num 32:17 , 36 ; Josh 10:20 ; 19:29 , 35 ; 1Sam 6:18 ; 2Kin 3:19 ; 10:2 ; 17:9 ; 18:8 ; Jer 4:5 ; 5:17 ; 8:14 ; 34:7 ; Psa 108:11 ( מ ׳עיר = מָצוֺר עיר 60:11 ), 2Chr 17:19 ; Dan 11:15 ( ׳מ in this connection singular except Jer 5:17 & Dan 11:15 ( מבצרות )); Jer 1:18 figurative of prophet, so without עיר 6:27 ; fortress, stronghold , literal without עיר etc. Num 13:19 ; 2Kin 8:12 ; Jer 48:18 ; Isa 17:3 ; 25:12 ( ׳מ חומתיך משׁגב ) 34:13 (|| ארמנת ), Lam 2:2 , 5 (|| id. ) Psa 89:41 ; Hosea 10:14 ; Amos 5:9 ; Micah 5:10 ; Nahum 3:12 , 14 ; Hab 1:10 ; Dan 11:24 , 39 ; followed by proper name ׳מ צֹד 2Sam 24:7 (compare Josh 19:29 מ ׳עיר צֹר ). בַּקְבֻּק בַּקְבּוק, see below בקק .
